title: WATCH: Trump's Own Words Prove HE Is the Source of Most Violent Rhetoric, Not the Left
author: Team Zeteo
content:
The Trump administration and its MAGA sycophants are blaming a "[left-wing
cult of hatred](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/karoline-leavitt-left-wing-
cult-of-hatred_n_69efb26fe4b08330e41f60d0)" for the alleged gunman who
breached a security checkpoint at Saturday's White House Correspondents'
Dinner. But as we show in our latest video from **Zeteo** , the president's
own words prove that most of the hatred in American politics comes from…
_him._

In addition to appearing to [dance on the
graves](https://www.bing.com/ck/a?!&&p=154510f47292b36ae8625d7617694e29bf52abd796d793cd89e223a57898406bJmltdHM9MTc3NzMzOTU3OA&ptn=3&fclid=41617df5-42a1-11f1-a74e-bcac8f0250fb&)
